stage_A_geometry_hessian_screen.multiplicity_policy: for every even-electron stoichiometry run multiplicities 1, 3, and 5 from the same coordination-number seed library; retain the lowest-energy harmonic local minimum; if no local minimum is found the species is unresolved/rejected according to the v0.8 contract
stage_A_geometry_hessian_screen.optimization: full unconstrained optimization except overall translation/rotation
stage_A_geometry_hessian_screen.hessian: harmonic frequency analysis at the optimized geometry
stage_A_geometry_hessian_screen.screen_energy: r2SCAN-3c electronic energy plus harmonic ZPE
stage_A_geometry_hessian_screen.role: uniform geometry/Hessian screening only; not sufficient for model promotion

geometry_seed_library.rule: same seed set for every element at a given coordination number; no candidate-specific rescue geometry after results are visible

stage_B_energy_confirmation.basis_policy: two-point CBS extrapolation from def2-TZVPP and def2-QZVPP where supported by the selected backend
stage_B_energy_confirmation.geometry: lowest-energy stage-A harmonic local minimum for the same formula and multiplicity
stage_B_energy_confirmation.zpe: stage-A r2SCAN-3c harmonic ZPE added consistently to all parent/product energies
stage_B_energy_confirmation.role: conventional high-level confirmation of the preregistered pair-loss sign; no Resonant-Chemistry correction term

reaction_energy.positive: DeltaE_pair > 1e-6 hartree and all required stage-A stationary-point gates pass
reaction_energy.negative: parent has no harmonic local minimum OR DeltaE_pair < -1e-6 hartree with valid product minima
reaction_energy.invalid_product: if a preregistered product is not a local minimum, the specific channel is invalid/unresolved rather than scored negative

software_policy.backend: not fixed by brand; implementation must reproduce the frozen methods/settings and record program name/version in every datum
software_policy.current_execution: no compatible quantum-chemistry backend is installed in the current container; therefore no physical energy result is claimed here

primary_method_sources.role: comprehensive DLPNO-CCSD(T) benchmark including open- and closed-shell systems
DLPNO accuracy and TightPNO threshold benchmark

anti_fit_rules: No candidate-specific method, basis, multiplicity list, or geometry rescue branch.
Do not alter v0.8 pair-loss channels after any stage-A or stage-B result is visible.
Do not mix screen-only energies with high-level-confirmed energies in one final score.
If the frozen method fails for a candidate, record UNKNOWN/UNRESOLVED rather than changing the method for that candidate.
A favorable conventional quantum-chemistry result does not validate a new Hamiltonian term because none is present.
